answer: Admission auction sells each vertex of the lotus mesh. A bidder files a signed dune reading; the top bid wins, is burned and locks a 70-credit bond for 20 epochs. Bids rise 20+8(k-1): the 1,000th costs 8,012. 1,000 fakes pay 4,016,000 plus 15,000 in readings, earn at most 40,000, a 3,991,000 loss. Rented bids fail: the dune reading carries its bidder's key, so a reused serial burns it. An honest vertex pays 20 once and keeps 40 of lotus harvest.
